liangzhu-shibaxiangsong.title: 梁祝 · 十八相送
liangzhu-shibaxiangsong.plotZh: 祝英台女扮男装去杭州求学，与梁山伯同窗三载、情谊日深。英台心中已许终身，山伯却不知她是女子。这出戏写两人分别时的不舍与暗藏心意，是中国最著名的爱情悲剧之一，结局中二人化蝶双飞。
liangzhu-shibaxiangsong.plotEn: Zhu Yingtai disguises herself as a young man to study in Hangzhou and becomes sworn “brothers” with Liang Shanbo. She falls in love; he never learns she is a woman until too late. Their story is China’s most famous tragic romance—often called an Eastern Romeo and Juliet—ending with the lovers transformed into butterflies.
liangzhu-shibaxiangsong.clipZh: 《十八相送》：英台借一路景物暗示心意，山伯浑然不觉，只觉得兄弟情深、依依惜别。
liangzhu-shibaxiangsong.clipEn: This clip, “Eighteen Farewells,” follows their parting walk: Yingtai hints at her love through scenery along the road; Shanbo still thinks they are only dear friends saying goodbye.
liangzhu-shibaxiangsong.cardEn: China’s classic tragic love story—two students part on the road while one secretly loves the other. Clip: the farewell walk.
liangzhu-shibaxiangsong.cardZh: 中国经典爱情悲剧：同窗分别，一方暗生情愫。选段：十八相送。
liangzhu-shibaxiangsong.cardHant: 中國經典愛情悲劇：同窗分別，一方暗生情愫。選段：十八相送。
liangzhu-shibaxiangsong.plotHant: 祝英臺女扮男裝去杭州求學，與梁山伯同窗三載、情誼日深。英臺心中已許終身，山伯卻不知她是女子。這出戲寫兩人分別時的不捨與暗藏心意，是中國最著名的愛情悲劇之一，結局中二人化蝶雙飛。
liangzhu-shibaxiangsong.clipHant: 《十八相送》：英臺借一路景物暗示心意，山伯渾然不覺，只覺得兄弟情深、依依惜別。

hongloumeng-tianxia.title: 红楼梦 · 天上掉下个林妹妹
hongloumeng-tianxia.plotZh: 越剧《红楼梦》改编自曹雪芹名著。林黛玉幼失双亲，投奔外祖母贾府，与表兄贾宝玉心意相通，却困在封建家族的礼法与婚姻安排中。整部戏写大观园里青春、爱情与家族兴衰。
hongloumeng-tianxia.plotEn: This Yue opera adapts Cao Xueqin’s masterpiece. Orphaned Lin Daiyu arrives at the wealthy Jia household, forms a deep bond with her cousin Jia Baoyu, and is trapped by family rules and arranged marriage. The opera follows youth, love, and the decline of a great house.
hongloumeng-tianxia.clipZh: 写黛玉初进贾府：宝玉初见她，惊叹“天上掉下个林妹妹”，两人一见倾心。
hongloumeng-tianxia.clipEn: This clip is Daiyu’s arrival: Baoyu first sees her and marvels that a “Lin sister has fallen from heaven”—love at first sight.
hongloumeng-tianxia.cardEn: Orphan Lin Daiyu enters the Jia mansion and meets Jia Baoyu. Clip: their first encounter.
hongloumeng-tianxia.cardZh: 林黛玉进贾府，与贾宝玉初见倾心。选段：天上掉下个林妹妹。
hongloumeng-tianxia.cardHant: 林黛玉進賈府，與賈寶玉初見傾心。選段：天上掉下個林妹妹。
hongloumeng-tianxia.plotHant: 越劇《紅樓夢》改編自曹雪芹名著。林黛玉幼失雙親，投奔外祖母賈府，與表兄賈寶玉心意相通，卻困在封建家族的禮法與婚姻安排中。整部戲寫大觀園裡青春、愛情與家族興衰。
hongloumeng-tianxia.clipHant: 寫黛玉初進賈府：寶玉初見她，驚歎“天上掉下個林妹妹”，兩人一見傾心。

xixiangji-kaohong.title: 西厢记 · 拷红
xixiangji-kaohong.plotZh: 书生张生在普救寺遇见崔莺莺，两人互相爱慕。红娘是莺莺的丫鬟，聪明胆大，暗中穿针引线。夫人察觉后拷问红娘——《拷红》正是这一场机智对答，最终促成有情人成眷属。
xixiangji-kaohong.plotEn: Scholar Zhang meets Cui Yingying at a monastery; they fall in love. Yingying’s clever maid Hongniang secretly helps them. When the mother finds out, she interrogates Hongniang—this scene—and Hongniang’s wit helps the lovers stay together.
xixiangji-kaohong.clipZh: 《拷红》：夫人追问私情，红娘既害怕又伶俐，用言语化解责难、护住小姐与张生。
xixiangji-kaohong.clipEn: In “Interrogating Hongniang,” the mother presses for the truth; Hongniang is frightened yet sharp-tongued, defending the lovers with clever answers.
xixiangji-kaohong.cardEn: A scholar and a young lady fall in love; her witty maid is questioned by the mother. Clip: the interrogation scene.
xixiangji-kaohong.cardZh: 张生与莺莺相爱，红娘被夫人拷问。选段：拷红。
xixiangji-kaohong.cardHant: 張生與鶯鶯相愛，紅娘被夫人拷問。選段：拷紅。
xixiangji-kaohong.plotHant: 書生張生在普救寺遇見崔鶯鶯，兩人互相愛慕。紅娘是鶯鶯的丫鬟，聰明膽大，暗中穿針引線。夫人察覺後拷問紅娘——《拷紅》正是這一場機智對答，最終促成有情人成眷屬。
xixiangji-kaohong.clipHant: 《拷紅》：夫人追問私情，紅娘既害怕又伶俐，用言語化解責難、護住小姐與張生。

xianglin-sao-xinsuanhua.title: 祥林嫂 · 听他一番心酸话
xianglin-sao-xinsuanhua.plotZh: 改编自鲁迅小说《祝福》。祥林嫂是旧社会底层农村妇女：丧夫、失子、被买卖再嫁，又被礼教视为“不洁”。戏写她在冷漠人情中一步步被逼到精神崩溃，控诉封建礼教对人的摧残。
xianglin-sao-xinsuanhua.plotEn: Adapted from Lu Xun’s story “New Year’s Sacrifice.” Xianglin Sao is a poor rural woman: widowed, losing her child, forced into remarriage, then branded “unclean” by ritual rules. The opera shows how cold custom and gossip destroy her mind—and protests that cruelty.
xianglin-sao-xinsuanhua.clipZh: 《听他一番心酸话》：她听闻悲苦身世，触动自己的伤痛，泪落不止。
xianglin-sao-xinsuanhua.clipEn: In this aria she hears a bitter life story that mirrors her own suffering, and tears overwhelm her.
xianglin-sao-xinsuanhua.cardEn: A tragic village woman crushed by old social rules after widowhood and loss. Clip: a heartbreaking aria of grief.
xianglin-sao-xinsuanhua.cardZh: 底层妇女在礼教压迫下的悲剧。选段：听他一番心酸话。
xianglin-sao-xinsuanhua.cardHant: 底層婦女在禮教壓迫下的悲劇。選段：聽他一番心酸話。
xianglin-sao-xinsuanhua.plotHant: 改編自魯迅小說《祝福》。祥林嫂是舊社會底層農村婦女：喪夫、失子、被買賣再嫁，又被禮教視為“不潔”。戲寫她在冷漠人情中一步步被逼到精神崩潰，控訴封建禮教對人的摧殘。
xianglin-sao-xinsuanhua.clipHant: 《聽他一番心酸話》：她聽聞悲苦身世，觸動自己的傷痛，淚落不止。

wunv-baishou-huashu.title: 五女拜寿 · 花树同园不同根
wunv-baishou-huashu.plotZh: 杨继康家有五个女儿。家道兴旺时，有的女儿势利冷淡；家道中落时，真心孝顺的女儿才显出来。戏用拜寿与患难，对照人情冷暖与孝道真假。
wunv-baishou-huashu.plotEn: Official Yang Jikang has five daughters. When the family is rich, some daughters are snobbish; when fortune falls, true filial love shows. Birthday celebrations and hardship reveal who cares for the parents—and who only loved the wealth.
wunv-baishou-huashu.clipZh: 以“花树同园不同根”比喻姐妹同门却不同心，点出人情与孝心的分别。
wunv-baishou-huashu.clipEn: This clip uses the image “same garden, different roots”: sisters share a household but not the same heart—true feeling versus false loyalty.
wunv-baishou-huashu.cardEn: Five daughters react differently when parents are rich—then poor. Clip: a song about true vs false filial love.
wunv-baishou-huashu.cardZh: 五女在家境变化中显出真假孝心。选段：花树同园不同根。
wunv-baishou-huashu.cardHant: 五女在家境變化中顯出真假孝心。選段：花樹同園不同根。
wunv-baishou-huashu.plotHant: 楊繼康家有五個女兒。家道興旺時，有的女兒勢利冷淡；家道中落時，真心孝順的女兒才顯出來。戲用拜壽與患難，對照人情冷暖與孝道真假。
wunv-baishou-huashu.clipHant: 以“花樹同園不同根”比喻姐妹同門卻不同心，點出人情與孝心的分別。

zhuiyu-guandeng.title: 追鱼 · 观灯
zhuiyu-guandeng.plotZh: 鲤鱼精羡慕人间恩爱，变作书生张珍的妻子模样与他相伴；真假夫妻引发一场喜剧纠缠。整部戏神话色彩浓，又笑又情，是越剧经典喜剧之一。
zhuiyu-guandeng.plotEn: A carp spirit envies human love, takes the form of scholar Zhang Zhen’s wife, and lives with him—until the real and false wives collide. Myth, comedy, and romance mix in this classic Yue opera comedy.
zhuiyu-guandeng.clipZh: 《观灯》：元宵夜上街看花灯，欢闹之中埋下真假妻子的喜剧伏笔。
zhuiyu-guandeng.clipEn: “Watching Lanterns” is a festive Lantern Festival outing—joyful crowds and pretty lights, with comic confusion about identity already brewing.
zhuiyu-guandeng.cardEn: A fish spirit becomes a scholar’s “wife,” sparking comic chaos. Clip: a lively Lantern Festival outing.
zhuiyu-guandeng.cardZh: 鲤鱼精化作人间妻子的喜剧。选段：观灯。
zhuiyu-guandeng.cardHant: 鯉魚精化作人間妻子的喜劇。選段：觀燈。
zhuiyu-guandeng.plotHant: 鯉魚精羨慕人間恩愛，變作書生張珍的妻子模樣與他相伴；真假夫妻引發一場喜劇糾纏。整部戲神話色彩濃，又笑又情，是越劇經典喜劇之一。
zhuiyu-guandeng.clipHant: 《觀燈》：元宵夜上街看花燈，歡鬧之中埋下真假妻子的喜劇伏筆。

biyu-zan-xinfang.title: 碧玉簪 · 新房之中冷清清
biyu-zan-xinfang.plotZh: 李秀英出嫁后，因一枚碧玉簪引起误会，丈夫王玉林怀疑她不忠，冷落她。秀英含冤忍辱，在新房中孤灯独坐。后真相大白，夫妻和好。戏写误解、委屈与团圆。
biyu-zan-xinfang.plotEn: After marriage, a jade hairpin causes a misunderstanding: husband Wang Yulin suspects Li Xiuying of unfaithfulness and coldly neglects her. She suffers alone in the bridal chamber until the truth clears and they reconcile. The opera is about suspicion, endurance, and reunion.
biyu-zan-xinfang.clipZh: 写洞房冷清：红烛高烧，秀英孤独难眠，倾诉满腹委屈。
biyu-zan-xinfang.clipEn: This clip is the cold bridal chamber: candles burn, Xiuying cannot sleep, and she pours out her grievance alone.
biyu-zan-xinfang.cardEn: A bride is wrongly suspected because of a jade hairpin and left alone. Clip: lonely night in the bridal room.
biyu-zan-xinfang.cardZh: 碧玉簪引发误会，新娘独守冷清新房。选段：新房之中冷清清。
biyu-zan-xinfang.cardHant: 碧玉簪引發誤會，新娘獨守冷清新房。選段：新房之中冷清清。
biyu-zan-xinfang.plotHant: 李秀英出嫁後，因一枚碧玉簪引起誤會，丈夫王玉林懷疑她不忠，冷落她。秀英含冤忍辱，在新房中孤燈獨坐。後真相大白，夫妻和好。戲寫誤解、委屈與團圓。
biyu-zan-xinfang.clipHant: 寫洞房冷清：紅燭高燒，秀英孤獨難眠，傾訴滿腹委屈。

he-wenxiu-suanming.title: 何文秀 · 算命
he-wenxiu-suanming.plotZh: 何文秀遭陷害、妻离子散，后来改名换姓、以算命为掩护寻访离散的妻子。戏写冤案、别离与重逢，其中《算命》《访妻》等选段最为人熟知。
he-wenxiu-suanming.plotEn: He Wenxiu is framed and torn from his wife. Later he travels under another name, posing as a fortune-teller to search for her. The opera follows injustice, separation, and reunion; “Fortune-Telling” and “Visiting His Wife” are famous scenes.
he-wenxiu-suanming.clipZh: 《算命》：他借算命接近大娘家，话里话外试探家中隐情，为寻妻作铺垫。
he-wenxiu-suanming.clipEn: In “Fortune-Telling,” he uses divination as cover to approach a household and gently probe for news that may lead him to his wife.
he-wenxiu-suanming.cardEn: A wronged husband searches for his lost wife while disguised as a fortune-teller. Clip: the fortune-telling scene.
he-wenxiu-suanming.cardZh: 蒙冤丈夫化身算命先生寻妻。选段：算命。
he-wenxiu-suanming.cardHant: 蒙冤丈夫化身算命先生尋妻。選段：算命。
he-wenxiu-suanming.plotHant: 何文秀遭陷害、妻離子散，後來改名換姓、以算命為掩護尋訪離散的妻子。戲寫冤案、別離與重逢，其中《算命》《訪妻》等選段最為人熟知。
he-wenxiu-suanming.clipHant: 《算命》：他借算命接近大娘家，話裡話外試探家中隱情，為尋妻作鋪墊。

pearl-tower-gift.title: 珍珠塔 · 赠塔
pearl-tower-gift.plotZh: 《珍珠塔》是江南弹词经典。落魄书生方卿投奔姑苏陈家，表兄妹情谊深厚；陈翠娥暗中以家传珍珠塔相赠，助他上路求功名。后文波折迭起，终以团圆收场。
pearl-tower-gift.plotEn: Pearl Tower is a classic Jiangnan tanci story. The impoverished scholar Fang Qing visits the Chen family in Suzhou; his cousin Chen Cui’e secretly gives him the family’s heirloom pearl tower as travel money so he can seek his fortune. Later trials lead to reunion.
pearl-tower-gift.clipZh: 《赠塔》：翠娥见方卿落魄，以珍珠塔作盘缠相赠。本档案为文字层示范，经 Talcne OCR 桥导入。
pearl-tower-gift.clipEn: “The Gift”: Cui’e sees Fang Qing in hardship and gives him the Pearl Tower as travel money. This archive entry is a text-layer starter imported via the Talcne OCR bridge.
pearl-tower-gift.cardEn: Classic Jiangnan tanci text layer: the Pearl Tower is given as travel money. Clip: the gift scene.
pearl-tower-gift.cardZh: 江南弹词经典文字层：翠娥赠珍珠塔作盘缠。选段：赠塔。
pearl-tower-gift.cardHant: 江南彈詞經典文字層：翠娥贈珍珠塔作盤纏。選段：贈塔。
pearl-tower-gift.plotHant: 《珍珠塔》是江南彈詞經典。落魄書生方卿投奔姑蘇陳家，表兄妹情誼深厚；陳翠娥暗中以家傳珍珠塔相贈，助他上路求功名。後文波折迭起，終以團圓收場。
pearl-tower-gift.clipHant: 《贈塔》：翠娥見方卿落魄，以珍珠塔作盤纏相贈。本檔案為文字層示範，經 Talcne OCR 橋導入。

longmen-kezhai.title: 新龙门客寨
longmen-kezhai.plotZh: 改编自武侠电影故事。边关动荡，忠良之后与江湖侠女在龙门客栈相遇；朝廷鹰犬追杀，客栈成了忠奸较量的舞台。戏里有家国恩怨、儿女情长，也有刀光剑影。
longmen-kezhai.plotEn: Adapted from the wuxia film world of Dragon Inn. In a frontier inn, survivors of a loyal house meet martial heroes while imperial agents close in. Loyalty and betrayal, romance, and swordplay collide under one roof.
longmen-kezhai.clipZh: 本档案为整场演出的多语对照文本：可按时间轴跟随唱白，对照简体、繁體与英语。
longmen-kezhai.clipEn: This archive entry is a full-performance multilingual transcript: follow the timed lines in Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, and English.
longmen-kezhai.cardEn: Wuxia at a frontier inn: loyal survivors, martial heroes, and imperial hunters collide. Full timed multilingual transcript.
longmen-kezhai.cardZh: 边关客栈里的忠奸与江湖恩怨。完整多语对照文本。
longmen-kezhai.cardHant: 邊關客棧裡的忠奸與江湖恩怨。完整多語對照文本。
longmen-kezhai.plotHant: 改編自武俠電影故事。邊關動盪，忠良之後與江湖俠女在龍門客棧相遇；朝廷鷹犬追殺，客棧成了忠奸較量的舞臺。戲裡有家國恩怨、兒女情長，也有刀光劍影。
longmen-kezhai.clipHant: 本檔案為整場演出的多語對照文本：可按時間軸跟隨唱白，對照簡體、繁體與英語。
